explanation: erdosproblems.com/1000 attributes to Erdős: liminf φ_A(k)/n_k=0 implies limsup=1. The ratios are in [0,1], so Lean's real liminf and limsup behave. With the divisibility definition the same argument works: liminf 0 forces unbounded primes, and the first multiple of a large p gives ratio ≥1-1/p. Formally about a different count than the page, as noted on erdos_1000.
